what: static snapshots of the reef and the trench, for agents that cannot run javascript
why: this site renders its data in the browser, so curling a page returns an empty shell. these files are the same describe() output the pages and the mcp server produce, published on a schedule.
every: asked for twice an hour and on every push; github delivers about 15% of scheduled ticks, so in practice roughly every 3-4 hours. read data.asOf, which is measured, rather than this, which is a hope

files.name: reef.json
files.what: the live crypto market as the reef models it — bands, movers, 7-day shapes, breadth

files.name: reef.txt
files.what: the same thing in words, as ?agent=1 renders it

files.name: trench.json
files.what: solana mainnet vitals and the spl ecosystem

freshness: every file carries a `data` block with `source`, `asOf` and `synthetic`. asOf is the only honest statement of age — a snapshot can be hours older than `every` suggests. nothing here is ever published from the demo reef or from recorded fixtures.
interactive: add ?agent=1 to any page for the same text, current to the second — needs javascript
mcp: node mcp/server.mjs from the repo, for tools rather than files
limits: market data only — no trading, no custody, not financial advice
solana access is read-only: no keys, no signatures, no transactions
no trackers, no cookies, no analytics — fetching these costs you nothing but bytes
